DatabaseError: Execution failed on sql '
                with named as (
                    select ticker, permno,
                           row_number() over (partition by ticker order by nameendt desc, namedt desc) as rn
                    from crsp.stocknames
                    where ticker in ('ORCL','MSFT') and namedt <= '2026-09-30'::date and nameendt >= '2023-01-01'::date
                ) select n.ticker, d.date, abs(d.prc) as close_price, d.ret, i.vwretd
                  from named n join crsp.dsf d on n.permno=d.permno
                  join crsp.dsi i on d.date=i.date
                 where n.rn=1 and d.date <= '2026-09-30'::date
                   and d.date >= ('2026-09-30'::date - interval '2 years')
                   and d.prc is not null and d.prc <> 0 and d.ret is not null and i.vwretd is not null
                 order by n.ticker, d.date
            ': (psycopg2.errors.UndefinedColumn) column "nameendt" does not exist
LINE 6: ...RCL','MSFT') and namedt <= '2026-09-30'::date and nameendt >...
                                                             ^
HINT:  Perhaps you meant to reference the column "stocknames.nameenddt".
